# SigmaDelta_Conversion

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method to convert continuous-valued neural network activations into spike trains using sigma-delta modulation, preserving temporal dynamics on neuromorphic hardware. Enables direct deployment of pre-trained ANNs on Loihi 2 without retraining, bridging the accuracy-efficiency gap in neuromorphic inference.
